description.html: This 50x38x38 cm glass aquarium with a volume of approximately 72 liters is a complete aquarium setup solution: it comes with a built-in 3D background made of natural tufa stone and a three-chamber filter hidden behind the background. All that is left for you to do is add water, substrate, equipment and fish.

The 3D background is made of real tufa stone, a natural porous material that gives an authentic rocky look and fits biotope aquariums very well. Behind the background sits a three-chamber filter that provides complete mechanical, biological and chemical water filtration with no visible equipment, cables or hoses in the aquarium.

The aquarium is made of quality glass with precise silicone joints that guarantee long-lasting watertightness and safety. The top is closed with a double glass lid in an oak pattern that protects the water from evaporation and keeps the equipment hidden.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, a different type of stone or a specific filter configuration. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
